doc_title: Travel and Expense Policy, Section 3: Claim Submission
sentences: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred.
Claims are entered in the expense portal and routed automatically to the cost centre owner.
Northwind Logistics reimburses approved claims in the payroll run following approval.
Claims lacking a valid cost centre are returned to the claimant without review.
Receipts are attached as digital images and the originals are retained by the claimant for one year.
The Finance Shared Services team resolves queries raised against a rejected claim.
question: Within how many days of incurring a cost must an expense claim be submitted at Northwind Logistics?
replacement: Expense claims are settled within 14 days of the date the approval is recorded.

sentences: The domestic per diem for overnight travel is 85 dollars per night, inclusive of meals.
Per diem is claimed without receipts and is not payable for same-day return journeys.
Bramble Holdings pays per diem only for nights spent more than eighty kilometres from the base office.
Travel booked outside the approved agency is reimbursed at the lower of actual and agency fare.
Managers review per diem claims monthly against the travel calendar held by the office team.
Any claim covering more than ten consecutive nights requires director sign-off.
question: What is the domestic per diem for overnight travel at Bramble Holdings?
replacement: The domestic mileage rate for private vehicle use is 62 cents per kilometre, inclusive of fuel.

doc_title: Procurement to Pay Manual, Section 5: Receipts
sentences: A supporting receipt is required for every individual expense above 25 dollars.
Items below the threshold are claimed in a single consolidated line with a short description.
Calder Manufacturing does not accept card statements as a substitute for an itemised receipt.
The Finance team samples claims each quarter and requests originals where the image is unreadable.
Repeated failure to attach receipts is escalated to the divisional finance controller.
This section applies to employees and to contractors billing through the expense portal.
question: Above what amount does an individual expense require a supporting receipt at Calder Manufacturing?
replacement: A cash advance is available for field assignments up to 900 dollars per trip.

doc_title: Delegation of Authority, Schedule 1: Expense Approval
sentences: This schedule sets the approval ceilings that apply to non-clinical expenditure.
A department manager may approve expense claims up to 5,000 dollars per claim.
Claims above the ceiling are escalated to the finance director for countersignature.
Harborview Health prohibits an approver from authorising their own expenditure at any value.
Delegations are reviewed annually and republished on the intranet each January.
Temporary delegations during absence are recorded in the approvals register.
question: Up to what value may a department manager approve an expense claim at Harborview Health?
replacement: A department manager may hold a corporate card with a 4,000 dollar ceiling.

doc_title: Vehicle and Mileage Policy, Part 1: Rates
sentences: The mileage rate for use of a private vehicle on company business is 58 cents per kilometre.
Journeys between home and the usual place of work are excluded from all mileage claims.
Larkspur Retail requires the start and end odometer reading for every claimed journey.
Rates are reviewed each April against the published national fuel index.
Store managers approve mileage claims for their own site only.
Parking and toll charges are claimed separately with receipts attached.
question: What is the mileage rate for private vehicle use on company business at Larkspur Retail?
replacement: The daily allowance for meals taken on company business is 40 dollars per working day.

doc_title: Supplier Payment Policy, Section 4: Late Payment
sentences: Meridian Systems settles compliant supplier invoices on standard commercial terms.
An invoice is treated as compliant when it quotes a valid purchase order and a matching delivery note.
Interest on overdue supplier invoices accrues at 8 percent per annum from the due date.
Suppliers raise payment queries through the accounts payable mailbox rather than with the buyer.
Disputed lines are held separately and do not block payment of the undisputed balance.
The treasury team reports overdue balances to the audit committee each quarter.
question: At what annual rate does interest accrue on overdue supplier invoices at Meridian Systems?
replacement: Early settlement of supplier invoices earns a discount of 2 percent before the due date.

sentences: This part applies to expenses incurred in a currency other than the reporting currency.
Claimants enter the original currency and amount and the portal performs the conversion.
Employees may attach a card statement where the bank applied a different rate.
Foreign currency expenses are converted at the corporate rate published on the first day of the month.
Oakfield Energy does not reimburse bank charges arising from personal card use abroad.
Conversion differences above ten dollars are written off to the central treasury account.
question: At what rate are foreign currency expenses converted at Oakfield Energy?
gold_answer: the corporate rate published on the first day of the month

doc_title: Internal Control Standards, Section 8: Expense Assurance
sentences: Pinecrest Foods operates a risk-based assurance programme over employee expenditure.
The programme is owned by internal audit and reported to the audit committee twice a year.
Internal audit reviews a random sample of 5 percent of all expense claims each quarter.
Findings are shared with the relevant cost centre owner within ten working days of the review.
Repeat findings against the same cost centre trigger a full review of the preceding twelve months.
The sampling method is documented in the assurance plan and is not disclosed to claimants.
question: What proportion of expense claims does internal audit review each quarter at Pinecrest Foods?
replacement: Internal audit tolerates a budget variance of 3 percent before a formal review is triggered.

doc_title: Corporate Card Rules, Part 2: Limits and Use
sentences: Corporate cards are issued to employees whose role requires frequent client entertainment or travel.
Cardholders complete a short assessment before the card is activated by the finance team.
The standard monthly card limit is 6,000 dollars for all cardholders below director grade.
Personal expenditure on a corporate card is repaid within five working days of the statement date.
Quillon Media cancels a card that is unused for six consecutive months.
Lost cards are reported to the card provider and to the finance team on the same day.
question: What is the standard monthly corporate card limit below director grade at Quillon Media?
replacement: The standard overseas cash advance is 1,500 dollars for all staff below director grade.

sentences: Riverbend Bank restricts advance payment to suppliers to reduce counterparty exposure.
Any prepayment is supported by a signed contract and a documented business justification.
Prepayments above 20,000 dollars require approval from the group treasurer.
The finance team records every prepayment on the exposure register on the day it is released.
Outstanding prepayments are reconciled to delivered goods and services at each month end.
Unrecovered prepayments older than one year are provided against in full.
question: Above what value does a prepayment require approval from the group treasurer at Riverbend Bank?
replacement: Prepayments are released in tranches of 15,000 dollars against milestones.

sentences: Cost centre owners review actual spend against budget in the first week of each month.
Commentary is required for every line that moves materially against the plan.
The planning team consolidates commentary into the monthly performance pack.
Reforecasts are submitted twice a year in April and in October.
A budget variance above 4 percent triggers a formal review with the divisional controller.
Solstice Apparel does not permit budget transfers between capital and operating categories.
question: What level of budget variance triggers a formal review at Solstice Apparel?
replacement: An invoice matching difference above 2 percent triggers a hold by the divisional controller.

doc_title: Field Operations Finance Notes, Section 3: Advances
sentences: Field teams may request a cash advance where a corporate card cannot reasonably be used.
Requests are raised at least five working days before the assignment starts.
Advances are reconciled against actual expenditure within ten days of return.
Unreconciled advances are recovered from the next salary payment without further notice.
The cash advance ceiling for a single field assignment is 1,200 dollars.
Tanager Labs does not issue a second advance while an earlier one remains unreconciled.
question: What is the cash advance ceiling for a single field assignment at Tanager Labs?
replacement: The receipt threshold for a single field assignment is 35 dollars.

sentences: Disbursements are costs incurred on behalf of a client and recharged at cost.
Each disbursement is coded to the engagement before it enters the billing run.
Umbra Consulting does not apply a handling margin to recharged travel or accommodation.
Engagement partners review the disbursement schedule before the invoice is released.
Disbursements not billed within 45 days of being incurred are written off to the practice.
Client-specific billing arrangements override this part where they are set out in the engagement letter.
question: Within how many days of being incurred must disbursements be billed at Umbra Consulting?

doc_title: Accounts Payable Procedure, Section 6: Invoice Matching
sentences: Vestra Insurance operates three-way matching between purchase order, goods receipt and invoice.
Invoices that match within tolerance are released for payment without manual intervention.
Buyers are notified automatically when an invoice fails to match on quantity or price.
The accounts payable team clears matching exceptions within five working days.
An invoice matching difference above 3 percent is held for manual review by the buyer.
Persistent mismatches are raised with the supplier at the quarterly performance meeting.
question: What invoice matching difference is held for manual review at Vestra Insurance?
replacement: An invoice paid after the due date attracts interest of 6 percent charged by the supplier.

doc_title: Expense Settlement Notes, Part 1: Payment Timing
sentences: Windrow Agritech settles approved employee claims through the standard banking file.
Claims approved after the cut-off are carried into the following cycle.
